question: Can an exported but undocumented ESP-IDF station RX policy make promiscuous AWDL reception ACK-capable?

method.source: Locally traced ESP-IDF 5.4 ESP32-S3 libnet80211/libpp call graph

confirmed: The private semantic wrappers are callable and stable in this bounded IDF 5.4 experiment.
Both profiles preserve passive AWDL action and multicast data reception.
Neither profile enables directed reception or automatic ACK behavior against the selected Mac AirDrop peer.
notClaimed: This does not disprove the previously captured ESP-to-iPhone bidirectional path.
This does not prove that no unexported HAL or firmware mechanism exists.
ESP-IDF versions other than 5.4 were not tested.
conclusion.decision: Keep the implementation behind a default-off, version-pinned lab flag and do not use it in the relay profile.
